title: VTC Members — Credentials
description: Fetch the membership-pair credential bodies a community holds for one member.

Response.title: VTC Members Credentials — response payload
Response.description: The documents the community holds for this member. Every credential member is optional; absent means the community holds no such document, which is a real answer rather than a failure.

did.description: The member these documents belong to.

membershipCredential.description: The community-issued Verifiable Membership Credential — the grant. A verifiable credential, carried verbatim and opaque to this schema. Maintainers must not re-serialise it — the bytes carry a proof over themselves. Matches the `vrcJsonld` idiom in vtc/relationships/list/0.2.

roleCredential.description: The role Verifiable Endorsement Credential. A verifiable credential, carried verbatim and opaque to this schema. Maintainers must not re-serialise it — the bytes carry a proof over themselves. Matches the `vrcJsonld` idiom in vtc/relationships/list/0.2.

memberVmc.description: The member-issued reciprocal VMC — the acknowledgement that completes the edge. A verifiable credential, carried verbatim and opaque to this schema. Maintainers must not re-serialise it — the bytes carry a proof over themselves. Matches the `vrcJsonld` idiom in vtc/relationships/list/0.2.

memberVmcReceivedAt.description: When the acknowledgement arrived. Paired with `memberVmc`; a maintainer must not send one without the other.

memberVmcBound.description: Whether the acknowledgement's digest was verified against the grant. REQUIRED so that 'not verified' is stated rather than inferred from silence. Declares no `default` on purpose — a declared default is materialised by the generated bindings and breaks round-trip idempotence for every existing document.
